text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Since I was granted a day off,
I decided to check out some shops I've had my eye on, but—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The greengrocer was so fun!
I mean, they cut the vegetables right there on the spot, just the exact amount I needed!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That moment when huge vegetables are sliced cleanly with a snap...!
It was such a dynamic and exhilarating experience♪

It looks like Satono Diamond
thoroughly enjoyed her day off.
